subject.title: Session model pinning persists indefinitely: snap-back probe (PR #82676) defeated by origin-field pollution upstream — repros on 2026.5.28 through 2026.6.7-beta.1, byte-identical paths

question: Should the repair clear or migrate only stale automatic fallback provenance, while explicitly preserving all `modelOverrideSource: "user"` overrides?
rationale: The current discussion contains both an automatic-fallback recurrence and a separate user-sourced stale-pin recurrence; merging their cleanup rules could silently discard intentional user routing choices.

options.title: Repair automatic provenance only
options.body: Correct the automatic fallback origin/write and probe path, and migrate only entries unambiguously marked as automatic.

options.title: Adopt a broader per-turn policy
options.body: Use the configurable fallback-persistence direction in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/80502, accepting a larger compatibility and product-policy decision.

options.title: Keep state unchanged pending design
options.body: Defer session-state migration until maintainers specify how automatic and user-selected overrides must coexist.

recommendation.title: Repair automatic provenance only
recommendation.body: Correct the automatic fallback origin/write and probe path, and migrate only entries unambiguously marked as automatic.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged fallback-probe work establishes the existing automatic-recovery contract implicated by this decision.
